note: v3130: The second eye on v3129 cleared the main fix — the tautology is gone and the allow-list genuinely comes from the surface map — and found one Low that is the same caller-callee shape as the rest of this arc. The producer built lanes with _lane_of, which strips and lower-cases; the consumer still split the raw string, so a name banked as Vault.apply would read as an invented lane while vault.apply is a real surface. No publisher does that today, since route lanes come from chronicle, fleet and roster and the lock and shelf names in this tree are lowercase — a producer and a consumer that disagree about what a lane IS is still the defect, not the trigger. STRAY still 2: shelf.rows and shelf.scene.
